title: Vesper and the Alibi
author: Juniper Crane
blurb: Bram Kavanagh, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
